Version history: (1) 05.01.2026 draft (DMS Sid=14; header date blank) -> archived; (2) 30.04.2026 revised draft No. 83/2026/A-16 (MP Rajpatra 30.04.2026, p.226(73) ff.) = latest draft; (3) objections and action-taken reports dated 24.06.2026 and 25.06.2026 (DMS Sid=24). instruments.title_en: Revised minimum wage rates incl. VDA effective 01.04.2024 under the Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (base-rate revision; DMS No. 68 dt 04.03.2024)
instruments.notes: L8. Notification एफ 4(बी)1/2014/ए-16, MP Rajpatra (Asadharan) No. 68 dt 04.03.2024, under MW Act 1948 s.5(1)(b), revising basic rates for the 67 scheduled employments from 01.04.2024 (draft proposals: MP Rajpatra Part 4(ग) 06.10.2023 and 13.10.2023). LITIGATION (from official DMS circulars): challenged by the MP Textile Mills Association and others (WP 10772/2024, 9401/2024, 11921/2024, 12606/2024, MP HC Indore); interim stay 08.05.2024 (petitioner association) and stay order 21.05.2024 => notification 15817-16066 dt 24.05.2024 applied the 2016 base (F.4(सी)1-2013-अ-16, MP Rajpatra 10.06.2016) + VDA from 01.04.2024 (unskilled Rs 10,175/month). HC disposed of the petitions on 10.02.2025 (paras 15-16 quoted in circular 6891): fresh revision for the employments added 19.01.2025 [sic; notification dt 15.01.2025, Rajpatra 17.01.2025]; petitioner association exempt. Circular 1/आठ/वेतन/भाग-3/2024/6891 dt 28.02.2025 para 03: the 04.03.2024 rates are again effective (+VDA) for all notified employments EXCEPT textiles/made-ups (36(क)), apparel (59(क)) and footwear (73); para 04: those three get pre-revision rates + VDA pending fresh revision. Arrears circular 4157-356 dt 18.02.2026 (from 01.04.2024) archived, not read. Pre-21.11.2025 MW Act notification: potentially saved under Code on Wages s.69(2) (DEC-042) - needs advocate confirmation.
